## Convergence that preserves different problems

No demonstrated same-actor, same-act, same-recipient, same-layer and same-time factual conflict survives the tested shared propositions. This does not make the specialists synonyms. Learned form and owned ends, effort and livelihood, social receivability, causal warrant, relational standing, artistic choice and utterance access ask different questions of overlapping scenes.

One conceptual tension must survive integration. AO-E01’s conjunction describes a responsible authored offer; it is not a necessary condition for fiction to have any consequential effect. Prescribed or harmful fiction can act on people. Reception establishes an effect without authenticating its account, retrospectively granting every permission or settling the author’s standing. The final synthesis must test that distinction rather than force a uniform use of “works.”

The positive lives also survive. Hinami’s earlier enjoyment and care are real alongside her proof system. Mimimi–Tama is a reciprocal friendship with ordinary pleasure, concealed receiving and costs, rather than a subsidiary romance illustration. Yuzu’s taste, inquiry, educational preference and chosen affiliations exceed maintenance labor. Mizusawa has owned love, educational exploration and negotiated action before any final vocation. Kikuchi’s books, family, poetry and selected company matter beyond the rescue manuscript. Supporting people retain particular work, tastes, refusals, recipients and incomplete knowledge.

Source distinctions remain consequential: Akiyama/group apologies differ from Konno’s unshown apology or restitution; Kawaguchi Mutsumi’s phone assent differs from Yuzu’s beneficiary/observer position; taking precedes assent while first sending follows it. Rena’s appraising words address Kikuchi, while contact with Fumiya is a separate rejected act. Prior bodily initiation, permission to continue and later gratitude have different scopes. Actual party interview/role-play initially reassures; later written Alcia criticism exposes preselection, receives a serious counterargument and is followed by Kikuchi’s methodological stop. None is actual Hinami testimony.

V11 already contains groundless assurance beside Fumiya’s competitive credential. V12 changes the proposed carrier, represented person and requested reliance; it is not the first discovery of belief without proof. Yoko’s earlier narrated birth gratitude, the fictional mother’s elaboration and Aoi’s imagined Nagisa revoicing retain different speakers/layers. The video’s room/scroll trigger is more exact than a mother’s face alone. A received story and small present self-liking count without recovered final testimony, durable cure or universal permission.

Nagisa’s intention, cause, counterfactual prevention and grade tension remain open.
